title: Fixed functors and canonical maps for pulled reductions
statement: The constant scalar restriction, exact constant inverse image, pulled completed reduction tower, scalar-insertion normalization, strict tensor normalization, exact evaluation and diagonal squares, pulled augmentation and limit comparison are the existing concrete constructions of the pulled-reduction comparison. Their names and bodies are preserved; no new coefficient object or derived functor is chosen. These use [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], [def-sp-constant-reduction-models] and [lem-weil-pbc-ordered-exchange-coefficient-comparison].

source.place: Tag 099N (lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case), proof of (5); the augmented strict-tower and evaluation normalization of the second paragraph of the current blueprint proof is made explicit.

proof.text: Use the concrete functors, actual model-site pullback unit, scalar-one insertion, exact localization squares and normalized restriction-of-limits isomorphism. These are the unchanged definitions formerly in the strict tower comparison module.

proof_origin.place: The strict-model and universal-limit-normalization portions of the original argument, separated by M1.
